Usage

The fraction of a grid of points that lies inside the region (test_region_points).

Samples the region v > 0.5 on a grid every step pixels (reg[::step, ::step], origin at (0,0)), and returns the fraction of grid points inside the region as np.float64 (0 to 1).

• a → grid spacing step = max(2, int((0.1 + 0.3*a) * min(h, w))) (10% to 40% of the shorter side, minimum 2 pixels).

• b is unused.

• 0.0 if there are 0 grid points.

A fine grid approximates the region's area fraction; a coarse one gives a rough indicator of "how many representative points fall in the region". The grid origin is fixed, so shifting the region slightly makes the value jump. If you want the area fraction itself, taking the mean of the region is more accurate. Testing 1 point is hx_test_region_point.
